items.description: The United Nations Security Council has called on the paramilitary RSF in Sudan to not launch an attack on the city of El-Obeid.

items.title: US-Iran talks to begin in Switzerland as Tehran says it closed Strait of Hormuz
items.description: The US disputed Iran's claim the waterway is shut, a move Tehran says was a response to Israeli attacks in Lebanon.

items.title: BBC sees destroyed villages in Israeli-occupied southern Lebanon
items.description: Travelling with a humanitarian convoy, BBC's Hugo Bachega has been given rare access to a part of Lebanon under Israeli occupation.

items.title: Lebanese turtle conservationist Mona Khalil killed by Israeli strike
items.description: Mona Khalil, who had refused to leave the beach she had spent years protecting, died after several days in hospital, an environmental group said.
